title: RSI Arena: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement with Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2610.33624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can AI agents autonomously train useful language models and improve them using feedback from users? We introduce RSI Arena, a two-stage study of autonomous post-training as a step toward recursive self-improvement. Ten frontier models act as training agents, each starting from NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base. During a six-day first stage, each agent has 1,000 GPU-hours and $300 in API credit on a shared 64-GPU cluster, independently selecting data, implementing training procedures, and choosing checkpoints. We evaluate their models on 20 benchmarks and through blind human evaluations. All ten agents produce working assistants, with the strongest model, trained by GPT-6 Astra, closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across 12 capability benchmarks. translated_title: RSI Arena：迈向基于人类反馈的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: AI智能体能否自主训练有用的语言模型，并利用用户反馈对其进行改进？我们提出了RSI Arena，这是一项关于自主后训练的两阶段研究，是迈向递归自我改进的一步。十个前沿模型充当训练智能体，每个智能体都从NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning 30B-A3B Base出发。在为期六天的第一阶段中，每个智能体在共享的64-GPU集群上拥有1,000 GPU小时和300美元的API额度，独立选择数据、实施训练流程并挑选检查点。我们通过20个基准测试和盲测人类评估对这些模型进行评估。所有十个智能体都产出了可用的助手，其中最强的模型由GPT-6 Astra训练，在12个能力基准测试中平均弥合了基座模型到Instruct模型差距的76%。在对回答长度和格式进行统计调整后，其人类偏好评分也接近NVIDIA Instruct。在第二阶段，每个智能体接收比较……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RSI Arena提出了一种两阶段自主后训练研究，让十个前沿AI模型作为训练智能体在有限算力和预算下自主训练语言模型并结合人类反馈进行改进，最强模型在能力基准上弥合了基座到Instruct差距的76%，是迈向递归自我改进的重要一步。
en_tdlr: RSI Arena presents a two-stage study of autonomous post-training toward recursive self-improvement, in which ten frontier AI models act as training agents to autonomously train language models under limited compute and budget with human feedback, with the strongest model closing a median of 76% of the base-to-Instruct gap across capability benchmarks.
